text:
Elaine (AE): Kicking off a quick sync for the MercuryHealth POC. They want a 2-week runway starting Mon. Need prompt inventory, baseline prompts to eval, and clear success criteria. Can SEs + PM confirm scope?

Matt (SE): I can own prompt inventory + baseline. Quick Q: do we run on hosted or dedicated for the POC?

Elaine (AE): Mercury asked for hosted initially but may require VPC if PHI shows up. Start hosted, document switch steps.

Juno (PM): Goals: 1) retrieval-augmented triage for patient messages, 2) summarization of visit notes, 3) intent routing. Each needs 50 eval prompts.

Matt (SE): Good. I'll draft inventory. Sample baseline prompts below — we'll use these for automated evals and human spot checks: 
```
# triage prompt (short)
You are an assistant for a healthcare inbox. Classify user message into: urgent, follow-up, routine. Return JSON {"label":..., "reason":...}

# summarization prompt (long)
Summarize the visit note into a 3-sentence patient-facing summary, preserve medical terms but simplify language. Include follow-up actions.
```

Sam (Product): Success criteria proposal:
- Accuracy: label F1 > 0.85 for triage on their 500-sample dataset
- Summaries: ROUGE-L improvement vs their current system by +12
- Latency: P95 generation < 400ms on test harness (hosted)
- Cost: avg token cost < $0.018 per 1k output tokens for the POC period
- Reliability: 99.5% availability during business hours

Nina (Pricing): Cost target looks tight for hosted with high throughput. We should offer a trial credit and propose Dedicated if they hit >50k requests/day. I'll draft numbers and a short paragraph for the SOW.

Lara (Security): Heads-up: Mercury is asking for a security questionnaire (AICPA + some SOC2 Qs) and data residency questions. For hosted: no PHI should be sent without DPA + customer consent. If they insist on PHI we need Private deployment.

Elaine (AE): Rick from Mercury is in the thread — Rick, confirm whether the data sent to the model will include PHI for the POC and whether Mercury can share the 500-sample eval set.

Rick (Mercury): Hi all — for the POC we can provide a de-identified 500-sample set for triage and 200 visit notes for summarization. Initial runs will be non-PHI. If things look good, we may bring PHI into a Private setup.

Matt (SE): Great. Action items from SE: 1) prompt inventory doc with categories + example prompts 2) baseline prompt set (50 per use case) 3) eval harness config (metrics, eval scripts) — aim to deliver by Thu EOD.

Juno (PM): Timeline check: Week 0 (this week) — ingest eval sets, baseline runs. Week 1 — iterate prompts + evals, human rater checks. End of Week 2 — final report and recommendation (hosted vs Private).

Elaine (AE): Nina/Lara, can you add short bullets for the customer-facing SOW and security caveats by Wed? I want to send a one-pager to Rick on Thurs.

Nina (Pricing): Will do. I'll include an optional Dedicated pricing band and a hosted trial credit line item.

Lara (Security): I'll add: DPA required, KMS for keys if Private, audit logs enabled, SCIM SSO optional. Also list acceptable de-id methods.

Sam (Product): One more note on eval metrics: add hallucination rate (factually incorrect statements per 1k tokens) and a small safety filter pass rate for PHI leakage checks.

Elaine (AE): Thanks — looks like we're aligned. Matt/Juno/Sam deliverables to Elaine + Rick by Thu. Rick: expect one-pager and SOW draft then.

Rick (Mercury): Thanks everyone — that timeline works. Appreciate the clarity. Looking forward to the draft. :thumbsup:
